services.value: PHILIS provides on-site analysis of environmental samples contaminated with chemical warfare agents, pharmaceutical-based agents, and toxic industrial compounds for chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear incident response actions, accidental chemical releases, and natural disasters. The labs provide organic chemical analyses (e.g., chemical warfare agent compounds/degradation products, pharmaceutical-based agents, volatile/semi-volatile organic compounds, PCBs, gas/diesel range organics, and organophosphorus/chlorinated pesticides) and cannot analyze coliforms in drinking water.
